difference being exactly the `E_STRICT` bit php removed from the mask in 8.4. Nothing was going to
report that: the value is used, not printed, so `error_reporting(E_ALL)` just sets a different
mask. A table of numbers can only be checked by asking php for each one.

php is asked through ONE program per engine rather than one per constant, because these are pure
